d: Picard er i et kapløb med cardassianerne, klingonerne og romulanerne for at opklare et fire milliarder år gammelt genetisk puslespil.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: I kortene
d: Jake and Nog risk an intergalactic incident in an innocent quest to lift Sisko's spirits.
The Enterprise and a Klingon ship must join forces to escape from a pocket universe that has been trapping starships for centuries.
The Enterprise must escort an alien princess to her marriage to seal an interplanetary alliance. In their journey, she becomes attracted to Kirk.
When a probe from an unknown alien source unleashes a devastating assault upon Earth, Enterprise is first recalled to Earth, then sent to search for the perpetrators.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Imperiets soldater
d: On a mission for the Klingon Empire, Worf realizes that his friend General Martok is no longer fit to lead.
When the genetic supermen remaining from the Eugenics Wars hijack a Klingon ship, Archer must rely on their creator, the criminal Dr. Arik Soong, to help hunt them down.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Tårerne fra Profeterne
d: Ignoring the warnings of the Prophets, Sisko leads an invasion into Dominion territory.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Krydsild
d: Odo's hidden feelings for Kira interfere with his duty to protect the Bajoran First Minister--who also happens to be attracted to her.
Archer stands accused before a Klingon tribunal charged for conspiring against the Empire, a crime that could land him a lifetime sentence on Rura Penthe.
While attempting to repair the warp engine of an alien ship, Trip inadvertently becomes impregnated and the Enterprise must relocate the ship before the baby is due.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Regler for operationer
d: The Klingon Empire accuses Worf of wantonly destroying a Klingon civilian ship during a battle.
Kirk, McCoy, and Sulu are stranded on a barren planet where a mysterious woman attempts to kill them one at a time, while the Enterprise must travel halfway across the galaxy to rescue them.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: En ulykke kommer sjældent alene
d: While Kira consults with Damar's rebel forces, Bashir makes a shocking discovery about the disease ravaging the Founders.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ofring af englene
d: When the minefield is soon to be demolished, Sisko leads a mission to take back Deep Space Nine.
With Columbia's help, the Enterprise crew grapples with sabotage to their ship as they pursue the truth behind the kidnapping of Phlox.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Prøvelser og tribble-problemer
d: Sisko travels back in time to a pivotal moment in the history of the original Starship Enterprise.

t: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Undergangen forestående
d: Sisko, Odo, O'Brien, and Worf enter Klingon territory on a suicide mission to expose Gowron, the Klingon leader, as a Changeling.
Det klingonske imperium er på randen af borgerkrig, og Worfs loyalitet er splittet mellem Føderationen og hans folk.
